title: Neuro-Geometric Graph Transformers with Differentiable Radiographic Geometry for Spinal X-Ray Image Analysis.
summary: Differentiable radiographic geometry and graph transformer analyze spinal X-rays across six diagnosis categories. Results evaluates classification on patient radiographs (1,613 cases as reported); study-data validation, not broad clinical utility.
